Good morning, team! Overall, our utilization of Claude Code yesterday showed fantastic momentum and strong baseline health. We maintained a steady and productive workflow while keeping our total spend at a highly manageable $142.62, reflecting great awareness of resource allocation across our active projects. 

As we look ahead to tomorrow, let's focus on two key best practices to further optimize our costs and efficiency: first, try breaking down complex, multi-layered tasks into smaller, more targeted prompts to help Claude Code hit the mark on the first try and improve our average score; and second, review our critical interventions (we had 2 logged yesterday) to identify patterns where we can provide clearer initial context or constraints. Thank you all for your hard work and adaptability—let's keep building together!
